criteria.name: Hook strength
criteria.notes: Two opening lines name the agency, the claim's timeframe, and the corrective punch before the see-more cutoff; minor deduction because Limani is named in paragraph 2, so the hook attributes the claim to the institution.

criteria.name: Claim load-bearing + AK stakes
criteria.notes: Named state official's verbatim transformation promise on Alaska's highest-volume public service; correction names legislators, OIT, vendors, 630,000+ residents, and the $1B+ program.

criteria.name: Steelman fairness
criteria.notes: Paragraphs 2-3 present the 116,000-hour figure, PFD scale, the obsolete legacy platform, and that a smart reader had every reason to expect delivery; no snark before rebuttal.

criteria.name: Counter-evidence quality
criteria.notes: Three items all in dossier: primary official pfd.alaska.gov (reverified), named vendor admission (Hu/StateScoop), Route Fifty timeline; Hu point rests on a single secondary outlet.

criteria.name: Factual density
criteria.notes: Named entities, dates, dollar figures in nearly every sentence: Limani, Saige, Dec 2024, 116,000 hours, 630,000 Alaskans, $1B+, pfd.alaska.gov, Hu, Route Fifty.

criteria.name: Source quality
criteria.notes: Attribution on two independent credible outlets for a named state official; counter-evidence anchored by a primary government source; primary claim source is credible-secondary, not a docket.

criteria.name: Voice match
criteria.notes: Direct analogue to post_001.md: binary-naming ('the binding constraint isn't capability, it's execution'), plain declarative corrective register, direct stakeholder close.

criteria.name: Readability (LinkedIn)
criteria.notes: Paragraphs 2-4 sentences; one 3-item single-clause bullet block; 421 words, 2733 chars, within word and char caps; scans on mobile.

criteria.name: Engagement question
criteria.notes: Role-specific, debatable procurement question tied to the corrected pilot-vs-transformation frame; no CTA or softener.

criteria.name: Business actionability
criteria.notes: Reader can reframe state AI contract announcements against confirmed-go-live milestones; no specific contract vehicle named.
